papers.title: RuleTrek: Benchmarking Agentic Rule Reasoning in Complex Scenarios
papers.summary: RuleTrek is a multi-domain benchmark that evaluates large language model agents on identifying, deducing, and applying domain-specific rules across complex, multi-file scenarios, revealing substantial performance gaps.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 60 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: τ-Emotion-Bench: Exposing the Interaction Fragility of LLM Agents through Real-World User Emotions
papers.summary: A benchmark and data pipeline evaluate and improve LLM tool-calling agents under emotionally varied user interactions by filtering ineffective trajectories and scaling supervised training.
papers.insight: Novo benchmark ou dataset, um sinal técnico que pode virar produto.

papers.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents
papers.summary: Hybrid Reasoning Agents combine latent internal reasoning with text-based external interaction via a unified architecture and specialized post-training, improving agent performance while reducing inference cost and token usage.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 25 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: The Thinking Leakage in Reinforcement Learning for LLMs
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning gains in hybrid reasoning models' NO-THINK mode largely stem from reactivating existing THINK-mode reasoning rather than learning new capabilities.
papers.organization: KAUST Center of Excellence in Generative AI
papers.insight: Vem com código aberto, fácil de experimentar.

papers.title: Many Right Answers, One Training Example: Removing Responder Noise from GRPO for LLM Recommenders
papers.summary: ReMaRk improves reinforcement learning for recommendation by scoring generated lists against all valid replies jointly, reducing training cost while matching or exceeding prior performance.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 39 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: ActionOPD: Distilling Decisions, Not Tokens
papers.summary: ActionOPD aligns smaller language-model agents with teachers via semantic action-level on-policy distillation, improving out-of-distribution tool-use performance without requiring shared tokenizers or teacher probabilities.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 51 upvotes no Hugging Face.
